entries.name: Brandon Aiyuk
entries.summary: Aiyuk's agent, Drew Rosenhaus, said Tuesday that the receiver is "100 percent healthy" and fully recovered from his November 2024 right knee surgery and plans to work out for interested teams once he's released by the 49ers, Dianna Russini of BetUS TV reports.

entries.name: Brevin Jordan
entries.summary: Jordan (foot/illness) has been ruled out ahead of Thursday night's game against the Colts.

entries.name: Drake Maye
entries.summary: Maye has suffered a fractured right fibula that won't require surgery but is expected to sideline him for some time, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Isaac Guerendo
entries.summary: Guerendo (pectoral) was working off to the side during practice Thursday, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Isaiah Williams
entries.summary: Williams (ribs) won't play in Sunday's game against the Chargers.

entries.name: Jake Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson didn't practice Wednesday due to knee and ankle injuries and won't be available for Sunday's game against the Titans, Todd Archer of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jordan Addison
entries.summary: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that Addison underwent thumb surgery earlier this week and won't be placed on injured reserve, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Josh Jacobs
entries.summary: Jacobs (finger) has a "realistic chance" of returning to action Nov. 25 against the Rams following the Packers' Week 11 bye, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Kyler Murray
entries.summary: Murray (hamstring) will miss Wednesday's practice, Kevin Seifert of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Marvin Harrison Jr.
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Omar Cooper Jr.
entries.summary: Coach Aaron Glenn said Friday that Cooper (ankle/hip) will be out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: Riley Leonard
entries.summary: Leonard (coach's decision) is inactive but will serve as the Colts' emergency third quarterback for Thursday's game at Houston.

entries.name: Sam Darnold
entries.summary: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

entries.name: Will Mallory
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Woody Marks
entries.summary: inactive

entries.name: Zachariah Branch
entries.summary: out

entries.name: Dalton Kincaid
entries.summary: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Matt Parrino reports.

entries.name: A.J. Brown
entries.summary: Brown (hamstring) is expected to miss multiple weeks, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Baker Mayfield
entries.summary: Mayfield (foot) is trending in the right direction to start Sunday's game against the Lions after looking good in Friday's practice, Scott Smith of the Buccaneers' official site reports.

entries.name: Bhayshul Tuten
entries.summary: Tuten (ankle/foot) was present for the stretching portion of Friday's practice before moving to a side field, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

entries.name: Bo Melton
entries.summary: Melton (thigh) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Vikings, Rob Demovsky of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Brenen Thompson
entries.summary: Thompson (hamstring) is inactive for Monday night's game against the Ravens.

entries.name: Brock Bowers
entries.summary: Bowers (ankle) was present for Friday's practice, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Caleb Douglas
entries.summary: Douglas (shoulder) is expected to play Sunday against the Bills, Barry Jackson of the Miami Herald reports.

entries.name: Carnell Tate
entries.summary: Tate (shoulder) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Carson Beck
entries.summary: Beck (back) will not practice Friday, Theo Mackie of The Arizona Republic reports.

entries.name: Charlie Kolar
entries.summary: Kolar (concussion) remained sidelined for Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Chris Bell
entries.summary: Bell (knee) remained a limited participant in Thursday's practice, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Chris Rodriguez Jr.
entries.summary: Rodriguez (hand) was listed as a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

entries.name: Darren Waller
entries.summary: Waller (knee) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Joseph Person of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Dontayvion Wicks
entries.summary: Wicks (ankle) was present for Friday's practice, Brooks Kubena of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Geno Smith
entries.summary: Smith (ankle) will practice Friday, and head coach Aaron Glenn said "things look promising for him playing Sunday," Brian Costello of the New York Post reports.

entries.name: George Holani
entries.summary: Holani is week-to-week after suffering an MCL sprain in Sunday's win over Las Vegas, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reported Monday.

entries.name: Ian Thomas
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Isaiah Likely
entries.summary: Head coach John Harbaugh said Friday that Likely is tending to a "minor thing" but should be good to play Sunday against the Jaguars, Jordan Raanan of ESPN reports.

entries.name: Jackson Hawes
entries.summary: Hawes (shoulder) was a late addition to Wednesday's injury report, Katherine Fitzgerald of The Buffalo News.

entries.name: Jakobi Meyers
entries.summary: Meyers (ankle) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

entries.name: Jared Wayne
entries.summary: Wayne (quadriceps) did not participate at practice Wednesday, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Jaylen Waddle
entries.summary: Waddle (concussion) was a full practice participant Thursday.

entries.name: Jonathan Mingo
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Jordan James
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Kayshon Boutte
entries.summary: Boutte's hip injury he suffered in Thursday night's win over the Colts doesn't appear to be serious, Aaron Wilson of KPRC 2 Houston reports.

entries.name: Kenneth Walker III
entries.summary: Head coach Andy Reid said Friday that Walker (groin) "most likely" won't be available Sunday against the Cardinals, Sam McDowell of The Kansas City Star reports.

entries.name: Ladd McConkey
entries.summary: McConkey (back) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: LeQuint Allen Jr.
entries.summary: Allen (hamstring) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice, Ryan O'Halloran of The Florida Times-Union reports.

entries.name: Luke Schoonmaker
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Mac Jones
entries.summary: Jones (illness) did not participate at practice Thursday.

entries.name: Mike Evans
entries.summary: Head coach Kyle Shanahan said Friday that the 49ers will make a decision on Evans' (Achilles) Week 11 status Saturday after listing the wide receiver as questionable for Sunday's game against the Vikings in Mexico City, Matt Barrows of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Ray Davis
entries.summary: Davis (hamstring) remained limited in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Seth McGowan
entries.summary: McGowan (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Thursday's game against the Texans, Jane Slater of NFL Network reports.

entries.name: Sione Vaki
entries.summary: Vaki (ankle) was a limited participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Skyy Moore
entries.summary: Moore's ankle injury is not considered serious, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Tommy Tremble
entries.summary: Tremble (knee) was limited in Thursday's practice, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Tyjae Spears
entries.summary: Spears (knee) was limited in practice Thursday.

entries.name: Zavion Thomas
entries.summary: questionable

entries.name: Andrei Iosivas
entries.summary: Iosivas (thumb) practiced fully Thursday, Paul Dehner Jr. of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Caleb Lohner
entries.summary: The Broncos opened Lohner's (lower body) 21-day practice window Wednesday, Parker Gabriel of The Denver Post reports.

entries.name: Christian Kirk
entries.summary: Kirk announced Wednesday via his personal Instagram account that he recently underwent meniscus surgery.

entries.name: Davante Adams
entries.summary: Coach Sean McVay noted Friday that Adams (hamstring) isn't expected to practice this weekend, Greg Beacham of the Associated Press reports.

entries.name: De'Zhaun Stribling
entries.summary: Stribling (ankle) was doing some work on the side at Wednesday's practice, Nick Wagoner of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Gardner Minshew II
entries.summary: Minshew (elbow) underwent UCL reconstructive surgery Monday, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
entries.summary: Croskey-Merritt (groin) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Jalen McMillan
entries.summary: Head coach Todd Bowles suggested Monday that McMillan (knee) isn't likely to immediately return to action following the Buccaneers' Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

entries.name: James Conner
entries.summary: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that he has no new updates on the status of Conner (foot), who is still "working to return to perform," Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports. "It was not a good injury," LaFleur said.

entries.name: Jared Wiley
entries.summary: The Chiefs placed Wiley (ankle) on injured reserve Wednesday, Matt Derrick of ChiefsDigest.com reports.

entries.name: Jonathon Brooks
entries.summary: Brooks (groin) is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Ravens, Joe Person of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Lamar Jackson
entries.summary: The Ravens believe "there's a chance" that Jackson (thumb) could return for their Week 16 matchup with the Browns, assuming all goes well in his recovery from right thumb surgery, Dan Graziano of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Malik Willis
entries.summary: Head coach Jeff Hafley said Monday that Willis (groin/core) has not undergone surgery and that the Dolphins are still determining if a procedure is needed, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

entries.name: Michael Pittman Jr.
entries.summary: Pittman (foot) participated in practice Thursday, Nick Farabaugh of PennLive.com reports.

entries.name: Puka Nacua
entries.summary: Coach Sean McVay revealed Friday that Nacua (knee) had surgery to repair his MCL on Tuesday and is on track to miss a couple of months, Sarah Barshop of ESPN.com reports.

entries.name: Roman Wilson
entries.summary: Wilson (finger) was a full participant in Thursday's practice.

entries.name: Terrance Ferguson
entries.summary: Ferguson (hamstring/ankle) isn't ready to return to game action, but the Rams still plan to activate him from injured reserve before Week 12 and keep him on the active roster, Adam Grosbard of The Orange County Register reports.

entries.name: Tyrone Tracy Jr.
entries.summary: Tracy (hamstring) could be reinstated from injured reserve when first eligible ahead of the Giants' Week 13 game against the 49ers, Dan Duggan of The Athletic reports.

entries.name: Wan'Dale Robinson
entries.summary: Coach Robert Saleh said Wednesday that Robinson (ankle) -- who was placed on IR on Tuesady -- is out for the rest of the season, Terry McCormick of TitanInsider.com reports.

entries.name: Will Shipley
entries.summary: Shipley (foot) remained limited in practice Thursday.

entries.name: Zavier Scott
entries.summary: The Bears placed Scott (wrist) on injured reserve Thursday.
